messages:
maya: Hey folks — need a short-lived console sudo to redact PII from a handful of prod logs. Hit a customer ticket with exposed emails. Will only touch logs in ai-ingest-prod, ~3 files. ETA 30m. Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2986

alex: Can you paste the exact justification + which hosts/namespaces? Also preferred time window?

maya: Justification: remove raw user emails accidentally captured by debug logs. Affected namespace: ai-ingest-prod. Hosts: ingest-gke-03 and ingest-gke-04. Window: 30m starting now if sec is fine.

security-bot: Policy checklist: 1) least-privilege role requested, 2) ticket attached, 3) audit logging enabled. Please confirm.

rachel: @maya thanks for the heads up. We need a scoped role (console:sudo:logs-redact) limited to those two nodes and to kubectl logs + s3 read for that bucket. No shell access. Can ops provide the exact RBAC/perm change?

ops-oncall: I can grant an ephemeral role via Vault for 45m. Will only allow `kubectl logs --namespace=ai-ingest-prod` and `aws s3 cp s3://redwood-prod-logs/ai-ingest/` read. Confirm the exact objects you need.

maya: Objects: s3://redwood-prod-logs/ai-ingest/2026-03-17/{ingest-gke-03,ingest-gke-04}-*.log.gz. Command I plan to run (dry-run first):

```bash
# stream, redact emails, write back to sanitized bucket
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-prod-logs/ai-ingest/$FILE - | zcat | sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/[redacted_email]/g' | gzip -c > /tmp/$FILE.sanitized.gz
aws s3 cp /tmp/$FILE.sanitized.gz s3://redwood-prod-logs-sanitized/ai-ingest/
```

maya: I will not exec into containers, only use logs + s3 flow. Will keep a step-by-step log in the Jira ticket.

rachel: ok. Security requirement: run this from a bastion with device MFA enabled (no personal laptops). Ops, please issue ephemeral credentials and annotate with INF-2986. Approve window: 45 minutes.

ops-oncall: Granting ephemeral role now. Vault token: issued, expires in 45m. Scope: logs-read, s3-read/s3-write to sanitized bucket only. Token ID: vault:ephem-7f3b (audit will record).

sam: Heads-up — when done, rotate any temporary creds, run `aws s3 ls` to verify no leftover public objects, and add an audit note: `INF-2986 redaction complete — artifacts sanitized`

security-bot: Approval recorded by rachel at 1768123620. Ephemeral grant logged: vault:ephem-7f3b.

maya: Running dry-run now, will post diffs in the ticket.

maya: Dry-run successful, sample diff attached to Jira. Proceeding with write of sanitized copies.

maya: Done. PII removed from listed files. Wrote sanitized copies to s3://redwood-prod-logs-sanitized/ai-ingest/. Updated INF-2986 with command output and checksums. :white_check_mark:

ops-oncall: Revoke token in 5m and confirm once rotated.

sam: Confirmed sanitized bucket has 3 files, checksums match posted ticket. Rotating any transient keys now.

rachel: Thanks everyone. Closing approval. Reminder: follow-up postmortem entry (one-line) in INF-2986 about preventing debug-level email logs.

maya: noted, will add the postmortem note. Thanks for the quick turn.
